It is a construction of a forgotten early age of man. They possessed a rare understanding of the underpinnings of the universe.
The word “temple” is your best modern translation. It is a consecrated space, but not meant for worship. This had a sacred but practical function.
A darkness exists beneath all things. Here, we see and feel it firsthand.
Long ago, those men could travel vast distances through the dark. Even travel between worlds was possible.
That power was volatile. It has long since evaporated. However, if the darkness could be fortified, perhaps some function may be restored.
As a Lord of the Kami, you have been granted a boon that may be perceived as a burden. You may now perform the ritual of Kami Sacrifice.

Oh, you mean my name? Zevana. I thought you might not really want to fight. You’re far too weak to stand up to someone like me.
A Kamigotchi is a small beast made of spiritual matter. Some people use “Kami” as a shorthand, but that’s technically wrong.
Most Kami represent the essence of a single thing, but the Kamigotchi are chimeras. Their bodies are made up of different pieces called Traits.
Traits determine a Kamigotchi’s Type, expressed as Type/Type. The four Types are Normal, Scrap, Eerie, and Insect.
For example, a Kamigotchi with a simple ghostly body and the forelimbs of a praying mantis would be Normal/Insect type.
Yeah, I know a lot about them. I like them! They’re cute! Want me to rip YOU into different qualities, you pathetic wretch? You’re so pitiful that… Well…
Oh, you’re asking for help? Unfortunately, I can’t protect you on your adventure. It would be cheating.
All I can do is sell you a Kamigotchi at a fair price. That’s my charge. You’d better take care of the little beast.
I’m talking about the Kamigotchi, not myself. Don’t be a dummy. Like I’d ever want to be friends with a thing like you!
My consummate professionalism is the only reason I’m speaking to you now.

Me? I fell. The sky, then the trees, then here.
I don’t remember anything before the fall. I’d like to go home someday, once I know where home is.
Until then I have tea, and him, and a frog who won’t leave for some reason. It’s a full house.
He was here before me. Before the hut too. The stones under him are older than the walls.
He’s always hungry. No, not that, that’s my spoon. Sorry. He does this.
Somebody lived here before. They left their jars behind. I’ve named all of them. That one’s Bartholomew.
Bartholomew is nettle and salt. Don’t open him.
If I’m not here, I’ve gone looking. The fire knows you. Sit with him until I’m back.
Bye! Mind the frog on your way out. He likes to sit where feet go.
What else? I like questions. One day I’ll have some for you.
A little badge! Someone was proud of you. Good. So am I.

A whole year of these? Don’t let Mina see it. She’ll probably try to buy it.

A few. Zevana visits.
